name: Just Translate
author: Akah Subarkah

sections.description:
Just Translate is a lightweight plugin that enables you to manage translations of your WordPress Website strings easily from the WordPress admin panel. It automatically detects and stores any string passed through the translation function and supports language prefixes in URLs (like /en/, /id/, etc.).

Features:

  • Automatically capture and store untranslated strings
  • Define multiple supported languages
  • Set a default language
  • Friendly admin UI for translation management
  • Filter untranslated strings
  • Bulk delete strings
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/just-translate
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to “Translations > Settings” to configure supported languages
  4. Add language switcher shortcode [wpjt_language_switcher] anywhere

short_description: Automatically captures and translates text strings using a custom translation panel with multi-language support.
